To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the new criterion of the predictive power of QSAR models named Index of Idealty of Correlation (IIIC) was proposed and tested on the data on toxicity towards Pimephales promela (fathead minnow); (ii) the proposed criterion seems to be more reliable than other metrics of predictive power of QSARS; (iii) the IIC can be used as the criterion to validate and compare QSAR models.
